input.title: Unisex Pit Bull – Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny pit bull lover hoodie is for the person whose tough-looking pittie hides behind the armchair the second the vacuum comes out of the closet.

A worried grey pit bull peeks over the back of a swirly striped armchair, paws gripping the cushion, while an upright vacuum waits on a round rug. SCARY DOG. runs above in heavy letters and AFRAID OF THE VACUUM. below.

Pull it on for cleaning day, cold dog walks and every house where the biggest dog is the biggest baby. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Unisex Pit Bull Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the lettering is printed in dark brown, and on Navy it is cream and mustard, so every word stays easy to read from across the room on either color.

Is it a good gift for a pit bull owner?
Yes. The Unisex Pit Bull Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. gives any pittie parent a joke they live every cleaning day, in an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for dog walks. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a long sleeve or a flannel.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the printed lettering and the worried pit bull looking sharp for years of dog hair and vacuum days.

Where does the print sit?
The Scary Dog. Afraid of the Vacuum. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with SCARY DOG. over the armchair scene and AFRAID OF THE VACUUM. beneath, so both lines read from across the room. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord for cold dog walks.
